description.value: A longitudinal study followed typically developing adolescents who were alcohol-naive at baseline for two years to compare brain-structure development in alcohol initiators and non-users using MRI.

spans.text: The current study followed typically developing adolescents from a baseline assessment, where no experience with alcohol was present, through two years, after which some individuals transitioned into regular use.

spans.text: T 1 weighted images were corrected for distortions caused by gradient nonlinearity and then submitted to the standard longitudinal processing pipeline in the FreeSurfer software suite
FreeSurfer software suite (v4.5.0

Difference maps for cortical thickness and white matter extent were created by subtracting each participant’s follow-up map from his/her baseline map, then smoothed at 10 mm FWHM prior to statistical analysis.

The standard FreeSurfer pipeline itself includes removal of non-brain tissue using a hybrid watershed/surface deformation procedure ( 58 ), automated Talairach transformation, segmentation of the subcortical white matter and deep gray matter volumetric structures including hippocampus, amygdala, caudate, putamen, and ventricles ( 49 , 50 ), intensity normalization ( 59 ), tessellation of the gray/white matter boundary, automated topology correction ( 48 , 57 ), and surface deformation following intensity gradients to place optimally the gray/white and gray/cerebrospinal fluid borders at the locations where the greatest shifts in intensity define the transitions between tissue classes ( 45 - 47 ).
